milestones.name: Save Zote from Vengefly King
milestones.note: Optional event along the path to Greenpath; Knight can save or abandon Zote

milestones.name: Zote dies in Forgotten Crossroads
milestones.note: Occurs if Zote is not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw; hitting his shell grants Neglect achievement

milestones.name: Neglect achievement
milestones.note: Granted by hitting Zote's shell in Forgotten Crossroads after he dies

milestones.name: Zote appears in Dirtmouth
milestones.note: Occurs if Knight saved Zote in Greenpath

milestones.name: Zote found in City of Tears corridor
milestones.note: Zote reappears in a corridor leading to storerooms of City of Tears

milestones.name: Zote saved from Deepnest
milestones.note: Knight finds Zote stuck in spider webs in Deepnest; can save or leave him

milestones.name: Zote as final boss of first trial
milestones.note: If saved both times, Zote appears in resting area of Colosseum of Fools as final boss of first trial; beating him grants Rivalry achievement

milestones.name: Rivalry achievement
milestones.note: Granted by defeating Zote at the Colosseum of Fools

zones.name: Forgotten Crossroads
zones.fingerprintHint: Area below Dirtmouth; highways and caverns connecting many areas of Hallownest; contains Ancestral Mound and Temple of the Black Egg sub-areas

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Town above Forgotten Crossroads; Zote appears here if saved in Greenpath

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected to Forgotten Crossroads; location where Zote is initially found held by a Vengefly King

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Connected to Forgotten Crossroads; Zote found in corridor to storerooms here

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where Zote is found stuck in spider webs

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where Zote is held captive and becomes final boss of first trial; has a resting area

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Referenced as a progression gate; if Zote is not saved before acquiring Mantis Claw, he dies in Forgotten Crossroads

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles; Knight can choose to fight it to save Zote or leave

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of the first trial; deals no damage due to shellwood nail; beating him grants Rivalry achievement

objectives.name: Save Zote from the Vengefly King
objectives.hopDescription: Find Zote held in the mandibles of a Vengefly King along the path to Greenpath and defeat the Vengefly King to rescue him
objectives.note: Optional; leaving him leads to his death if Mantis Claw is acquired first

objectives.name: Save Zote from Deepnest
objectives.hopDescription: Find Zote stuck in spider webs in Deepnest and free him
objectives.note: Optional; leaving him this time does not result in his death

objectives.name: Defeat Zote at the Colosseum of Fools
objectives.hopDescription: Attack Zote until the boss fight ends to earn the Rivalry achievement
objectives.note: Only available if Zote was saved both in Forgotten Crossroads and Deepnest

objectives.name: Obtain the Neglect achievement
objectives.hopDescription: Let Zote die in Forgotten Crossroads (do not save him before acquiring Mantis Claw), then hit his shell
